    {
      "stars": 1,
      "title": "My Experience with Bankers HealthCare Group",
      "text": "BHG aggressively pursued my business and their marketing pitch looked promising. But upon initiating an inquiry and beginning an application, I discovered legal issues.\n\nThe 1st was they asked for a signed IRS Form 8821 authorizing release of 12 YEARS of tax returns to be processed by a 3rd party contractor. The 2nd was binding legal issues. I communicated my concerns BHG as follows:\n\n\"I was looking forward to a long and mutually beneficial business relationship with Bankers Healthcare Group. Upon reading the boilerplate found in total with the application, it unfortunately grants Bankers Healthcare Group along with literally any and all entities with whom you currently or in the future establish any business relationship AND any entities they have any relationship with full and unencumbered access to my historical and future personal and tax records. Secondly, it requires that I WAIVE ANY RECOURSE regarding the potential misuse or application of said information IN PERPETUITY. That is a particularly onerous and heavy burden to accept. Should you decide to move forward with my application without requiring me to expose myself and my business to such dangers, I would welcome the opportunity.\"\n\nAfter a phone and email conversation with a Sales Mgr., he offered to process the application without me signing away my rights (until the loan went through underwriting and was approved) and further agreed to only 2 years IRS tax records access.\n\nRather than be exposed to any other dangers, I chose to determine if their RATES, TERMS and FEES were reasonable BEFORE processing an application. In the name of TRANSPARENCY, I requested a BLANK copy of their loan contract. I hoped that there were not any other legally binding terms that would expose me and my business to the DANGERS of identity theft or sale of my personal information in perpetuity.\n\nThat request was refused.\nAs of today, that is where the process stands.\n\nFebruary 16,2022 Addendum\n\nUpon reading the BHG response and the posturing therein, it behooves me to share the ACTUAL clauses from the application that expressly support the DANGERS to which a potential borrower is agreeing. It was due to some of the negative POST APPROVAL reviews read here on TrustPilot and BBB that demanded closer inspection of potential pitfalls before opening a pandoras box of regret.\n\nPay particular attention to the definition of \"Assignee\" in Section 5 and then loop back to Sections 3 and 4.\n\n\"The Owner(s)/Officer(s) and Merchant identified above (individually, an “Applicant”) each represents, acknowledges and agrees that (1) Applicant will immediately notify Bankers Healthcare Group, LLC (“BHG”) of any change in the information or documents provided to BHG in connection herewith or Applicant’s financial condition, (2) each Assignee (as such term is defined in item (5) below) will rely upon the accuracy and completeness of such information and documents, (3) BHG, Assignees, and each of their representatives, successors, assigns and designees (collectively, “Recipients”) are authorized to request and receive any investigative reports, credit reports, statements from creditors or financial institutions, verification of information, or any other information that a Recipient deems necessary, (4) Applicant waives and releases any claims against Recipients and any information-providers arising from any act or omission relating to the requesting, receiving or release of information,(5) Applicant authorizes BHG to disclose all information and documents that BHG may obtain including credit reports to other persons, affiliates, partners or entities (collectively, \"Assignees\") that may purchase BHG referral lists and/or marketing databases or be involved with or acquire BHG commercial loans, commercial loans having daily repayment features, and/or Merchant Cash Advance transactions, including without limitation the application therefore (collectively,\n\"Transactions\") and each Assignee is authorized to use such information and documents, and share such information and documents with other Assignees, in connection with potential Transactions, (6) all information and documents provided to BHG including credit card processor statements are true, accurate and complete, and (7) each Owner/Officer represents that he or she is authorized to sign this form on behalf of Merchant. I consent to the verification of my income and employment through a credit bureau.\"\n\nI recognize that BHG is successful in their chosen lending markets and COULD, if they so choose, become a Premier Partner to my business and others, now and in the future, by removing these dangerous traps.\nUpdate No.2 February 16, 2022\nBHG Privacy Policy contradicts the answer here",

    {
      "stars": 5,
      "title": "VIP treatment from start to finish!",
      "text": "I had an extremely positive experience when applying for a loan with BHG. Everyone I interacted with was very courteous, professional, friendly and efficient, and helped move me smoothly through the entire process within a matter of a couple of days; considering that my inquiry began just before a long holiday weekend, I imagine that the process would have been completed within 24 hours or less had it not been for that delay. All in all, it was a very easy and seamless process. As a contract RN who works overnight shifts, I don't have much time or energy during the day to deal with business matters, so it was obviously important to me that this was not going to be a hugely time-consuming process. Fortunately, BHG representatives seemed to understand that situation, and were able to gather information and work around my schedule accordingly. My loan was approved quickly, and on the day of approval, the funds were available in my account that evening. Within less than 24 hours after approval, I had another BHG representative contact me about the 0% interest credit card that was offered as part of the loan, and this person educated me on the terms, walked me through activation, and helped me to utilize the card effectively in conjunction with the loan. Overall it was a great experience, and I honestly felt like I was respected, accommodated and treated like a VIP from start to finish. Thank you BHG, I will definitely be recommending you to my healthcare colleagues!",

    {
      "stars": 5,
      "title": "short and sweet",
      "text": "short and sweet, at first I was disheartened with my initial online quote so I didn't persue the offer cause it honestly did not look that attractive for me. I recieved a text to disuss my loan options and later agreed on a phone call and worked directly with their staff to provide information that would have otherwise been left out of my income all of which was factored even more postively on my chances. I recieved a call later, 3 days later mostly because of the holiday and weekend from the agent and one word, \"congradulations you are approved\" and for the terms that worked for me based on my Credit profile not what the simulated profile suggested. I was more than pleased with my offer. I would say that for some these loans may have some interesting caveats that you have to be clear about and always ask questions which they are happy to answer, very transparent which gave me room to ponder to a decision that would meet my personal goals. Ultimately your credit profile is yours only and each person is unique but I can say one thing is for sure, BHG came through for me which is why I am writing this review in hopes anyone else looking for positive reenforcement about deciding to go with BHG would help make that decision that much easier to make, it was not for me until I laid out my terms and they met me half way and then some which totally shocked me, but your FICO is critical to negotiating those terms, good luck if you work with them, you might be even more pleased than I was, it helped me kick of 2022 smiling. I am very happy folks. at least explore your options with them all without risk, worst that can happen is you know where you stand for the year knowing you have a snapshot of your own FICO and personal finances in mind.",

      "title": "BHG was very easy to work with",
      "text": "BHG was very easy to work with. The application was simple and the rest of the process went very smoothly. Any questions I had were answered quickly. I did not want to be tied to something that I could not pay off so I was happy with the terms they offered. Another plus was that this loan does not show up on my credit report. Being self employed, we tend to carry a lot of debt both professionally along with personally. It does affect your debt to income ratio which hurts your ability to borrow.       "title": "Wonderful and Surprising!",
      "text": "I was very skeptical of BHG at first. He did! Each of the BHG employees I dealt with were very friendly and relaxed and not pushy at all. You get the money that you need at a rate and fee that is not only affordable but surprisingly good.\n\nThe only criticism I have is the credit card offer at the end is kind of slipped in and you have to really listen to the final offer details and let them know if you do not want to take advantage of the credit card offer.     {
      "stars": 5,
      "title": "I am a very skeptical person, BHG proved themselves.",
      "text": "I am a very skeptical person, by nature. So when I reviewed BHG’s offer and did my homework on the company, I was surprised to find myself willing to pursue the loan. The initial contact from BHG was cordial and I was referred to Jessica S. for contractual discussions. I give her credit for being patient and being willing to work with me to get the best offer available to meet my needs. Once I was in agreement with the contract, my loan was funded the same business day. My escrow funds were released the same business day I submitted the requisite information for release. I read tons of reviews on BHG prior to deciding to work with them, many like the one I’m writing now. I offer this advice, take your time when shopping for a loan. Don’t make emotional decisions, READ your contract! All the negative reviews I have seen were indicative of situations were the customer either defaulted and was salty, or did not read the contract they signed. I waited until all funds had been released to script this review, as a skeptic would. Along the entire journey, BHG did what they said they would do so I am happy with the experience.",
      "company_response": "",
      "reviewer": {

        "location": "",

    {
      "stars": 5,
      "title": "For Professionals Who Need to Get Their Financial Picture Back on Track",
      "text": "First, let there be no mistake, I am not affiliated in any way with BHG. This review is based solely on my experience. I have read several negative reviews, and take them with a grain of salt, but like everything, there are two sides to every story and the truth is in the middle. Having significant knowledge of business management and understanding how finance and accounting work further reinforces my current experience with BHG.\n\nI needed to reset my entire financial picture going through a difficult divorce the past three years, coupled with being a high income earner, getting an unsecured commercial loan was the best solution for me taking all things into consideration to minimize and eliminate my debt. If this loan were secured, it would completely defeat the purpose of paying off debt and your credit and FICO scores would be obliterated because now your incurring debt while paying off debt. This is counterintuitive to solving your financial debt, so this difference alone makes all the difference.\n\nEveryone's rates are based on their current financial picture, and BHG takes a risk entrusting you with a loan, and they assess your risk to determine the rate and terms that work out best for you. Most credit card debt today is easily between 14.99 to 25% interest. The average card for most professionals have a credit limit between $15,000 - $25,000 easily. Now max out those cards and calculate compounding interest. Your interest rates will not change unless you haggle with the card company, plus just paying the minimum alone will keep that debt going for 25 or more years. This is not worth the pain to go through.\n\nEnter BHG, pay your debt which can easily average between $50,000 or more for most professionals, and in my case not including my mortgage and cars, was north of $85,000. What do I get after assessing my current credit picture from a \"soft credit pull,\" plus risk, I get approved for $140,000, however; my equilibrium point is $105,000 with a 10 year term and a fixed rate of 22.24%. now, let think about this...this is a unsecured high-risk loan, and at least have of my credit card debt interest to cover legal fees exceeded 25-29.99%. Other cards were 6.89% - 14.99%. So, do I spend paying 25+ years with a variable rate that will continue going up because I can only pay the minimum, or do I take 22.24% fixed and pay everything off in 10 years, and my monthly payments are at least $500 or more saved each month, compared to what I was paying. Let me remind you that this is similar to a car loan on steroids with light at the end of the tunnel; this is a commercial loan and not any other type of loan. There are rules for these types of loans.\n\nOk, yes there will be fees and that will vary based on variables of your financial picture. Many folks complain about this, but every lender charges fees period. BHG needs to make money too. As a direct lender, they need to cover their loan interest and pay their overhead. If you are a business professional and/or owner, this is no surprise. Everyone in this category must be able to cover their overhead capital. I even have a reimbursable fee of about $3500 that is returned after the loan is paid in full. There will be requirement that need to be met and being high risk, I cannot complain because I can make the payment. Because this is an unsecured commercial loan, you may not be able to prepay or pay off early. You will incur a penalty. This is very fair. I have to pay 4 years of payment before I can make any modifications with BHG for the remainder of the loan. I am sure that 22.24% will decrease significantly to about half of this. Remember, BHG is taking a risk on me, so I need to prove I can handle their terms while at the same time repairing my over credit and FICO scores. We all know you get the best rates and terms by doing this.\n\nFinally, read the entire contract, it's all in there. BHG in my opinion is a great solution when you use them right!",

    {
      "stars": 5,
      "title": "BHG's Quick and Stress-Free Loan Process",
      "text": "I required a substantial loan in the amount of $250,000, in order to upgrade my rental property. I had considered refinancing my mortgage, since the interest rates are low, however, that process would have taken at least 90 days to expedite, incur substantial closing fees, require much documentation, and I needed funding without delay for my upcoming projects--NOW. I learned about BHG through a new mailing I recently received, and inquired about their loan application process on line. A BHG representative, Christian Glisson, contacted me immediately, and took the time to listen to my reasons for needing a loan. He walked me through the process, clarifying everything each time I had a (repetitive) question, as did the other team members. In the short amount of time that the BHG team assisted me, I was thankful that it was a simple, stress-free process, especially since I can pre-pay the loan without penalty, which would have been a deal-breaker for me if I had to commit to several years of payments. I want to also recognize and thank other members of the BHG team, namely...Patrick Lewellyan and Nicholas Huber for their prompt, professional and courteous manner, as well as Takeyla Ellis, who contacted me as my funding was being processed, and presented me with a nice perk to consider; a BHG MasterCard with a 0% rate for a year and 2% cash back each time I use the card. Also included is a very good credit limit, not offered by my bank's current credit cards. I authorized Ms. Ellis to put in the application for me, and should receive my BHG MasterCard within 7-10 days. It took several days from start to finish, however, once everything was verified and approved, the $250,000 funding appeared in my business bank account within 24 hours. For these reasons, I recommend (without hesitation) BHG to anyone who needs a loan asap.",

    {
      "stars": 1,
      "title": "Predatory Business",
      "text": "Our experience has been less than satisfactory from start to finish. When we were first discussing loan terms and options with a representative named Michael, we specifically asked him if we can delay funding because we didn't need it until about two months after that point. He assured us that he had gotten an approval to delay funds and then pressured us to sign on the dotted line. He then stopped responding to calls and emails. We later found out he went on paternity leave. After that we were working with his supervisor, who told us that delayed funding is not an option and that we had to accept funding immediately on the loan or we would have to start over. Clearly Michael lied to us to get commission on this loan knowing he was leaving on paternity leave. We had to strongly advocate for lowered repayment penalties so that we wouldn't have to pay back more than double what we were borrowing. The representative, Ebony, who performed the recorded verification for the loan was rude on the phone. She harassed me while I was at work by calling my phone 7 times including 5 voicemails between 2:15 and 4pm in one afternoon to perform the recorded verification to release funds when we hadn't even agreed to anything yet. Then we asked her questions when I answered on the 7th call, and she acted annoyed that we had questions when no one told us to expect this call. Lastly, after this recorded verification they told us that we qualified for a business credit card for 0% APR. After agreeing to the card, we found out it is only 0% APR for balance transfers and 20% for purchases. Since then, we have been harassed with emails and phone calls about the credit card even though we have told them multiple times that we are not interested in activating or using it. All in all, this was a very disappointing and disheartening experience for two medical professionals trying to open a business after residency. We only agreed to this loan because with two credit scores over 700 and guaranteed income, this was still our best option. Beware if you can, they are only interested in making money.",

    {
      "stars": 5,
      "title": "Gateway to Business Development Dreams!",
      "text": "Too good to be true...that's what I thought when I received the first marketing mailer. After ignoring the first few I finally decided to apply and three weeks later I was funding with BHG. The rates, terms, loan amounts, and associated fees are fair. Staff is professional, helpful, and responsive. Process is secure and extremely transparent. Moving my business development from planning to execution is a dream come true. I'm sure everyone's experience will be different but encourage anyone needing the capital to take their business plans to the next level to look into BHG's offerings. Best wishes and I hope you have a great experience too. Good luck.",

    {
      "stars": 5,
      "title": "More Than Happy",
      "text": "I am very pleased with my Bankers Healthcare Group experience. They have given me the opportunity to “start over” and work my way to owning my my own business in the future. I feel the necessity to negate some of the reviews written by saying: BHG loans do not report on your credit! With that being said, an interest rate of 12-19% is phenomenal, and significantly better than the average credit card APR of 16-24% which DOES report on your credit, and CAN have negative implications. Also, for those that are sour that “they were not told they cannot pay the loan off early” - I find this extremely difficult to believe as they were upfront from the beginning of discussing my loan with them that there is required period you are bound to the loan repayment. In my case, it was not a deal breaker at all as I do not have plans on paying the loan back before this period of time. Not only this, everyone I talked to was extremely pleasant and worked diligently to get the funds to me in a timely manner. I appreciate this being offered to healthcare workers such as myself, as it is truly helping me plan my future. Thanks Banker’s Healthcare Group!",

      "stars": 1,
      "title": "I doubt the positive reviews are real",
      "text": "So, I got a mailer from BHG. I called and they said they could probably provide a loan with an interest rate in the high single digits. So, I gave them a lot of information. A few days pass and then they text me and I ask what the interest rate is and Alissa Davis told me \"I have no idea but Travis can discuss that with you.\" So, I schedule a call with Travis and he calls, I say \"I don't have much time, what is the interest rate?\" He says \"should I call back later?\" I say \"no, let's just be quick\" And he rambles on-and-on. I cut him off. Then tells me I can have 36K and the monthly payments (which sound crazy high to me) and then he finally tells me the interest rate is 24%!!     {
      "stars": 5,
      "title": "BHG...The best group around!",
      "text": "I had received a loan proposal and decided to try and see if I could get funded a large amount, in order to pay off my bills and try to follow thru with some home repairs that this old house needs. While I was not able to borrow as much as I wanted, the amount offered was enough to pay off my bills and the monthly payment...which is equal to about what I would pay if I just made the minimum payments each month...was something I could afford.\n\nThe staff at BHG was courteous, and helpful...every step of the way. Multiple people chimed in to aid me, when I needed it. Plus I had about 50 days between when I was funded and when my first payment was due, so the money I earned during that time I was able to use towards some of the things that needed doing around the house. The funds were delivered to me promptly and easily. My rating for this group is 5 stars...it would be more if I could give it but I do need to stay within the scale. If you...the one reading this..is considering using BHG, I recommend them completely. I'm grateful that I took the chance. And as a bonus, my FICO score improved too. That's a win-win!",

    {
      "stars": 1,
      "title": "Terrible company and a giant waste of time",
      "text": "Terrible company and a giant waste of my time. They advertise that they offer easier financing solutions and are more efficient than dealing with the larger lending institutions. What a joke! They were very efficient at collecting all of my personal information and I spent hours on the phone with them completing the application process. Ten days past, and I had not heard a word from them. I emailed the people I had been working with and asked them for a status update. I received an email from someone else at another company telling me that he was told that I was interested in an SBA loan. I emailed him back and asked him where he got my information and what would lead him to believe I am interested in an SBA loan. He emailed me back and told me he works for an affiliated company that owns BHG, and they deal with SBA loans. I told him I am absolutely not interested in an SBA loan because this is a quick close purchase and the government doesn't know how to move quickly or efficiently. As someone said in another review, this is a bait and switch, unethical company. If someone like me with no debt, high net-worth, and great FICO score can't get a loan with these people, good luck.",
      "company_response": "",
      "reviewer": {
        "name": "Anonymous",
        "location": "",
        "reviews_count": null
      },
      "date": {
        "published": "2020-09-29T00:52:02.000Z",

    {
      "stars": 5,
      "title": "I was super skeptical …",
      "text": "I was super skeptical when I received their flyer in the mail but, having some plans to expand my business, thought it was worth a shot to see if they could help me. As a financial services professional, I had watched several of my existing clients who are also business owners, try ordinary banking channels only to be frustrated and turned down. So my expectations were quite low.\n\nI submitted my application on Sunday afternoon before Memorial day. I received my first follow up contact from BHG first thing Tuesday morning and with minimal effort on my part, had finalized my application with one phone call and a follow up fax. But I remained skeptical.\n\nThrough the efforts of several BHG team members, all of whom were super responsive and helpful, my loan was funded the following Monday. Less than one week from application to funding when I had watched my clients get put through the wringer for weeks only to be denied. Guess who I will be referring my clients to next time I have the opportunity?\n\nNow I have the operating capital I need to get this new component of my business off the ground without the stress of how to fund it from existing operations. I simply could not be happier with the service, care and outcome BHG was able to provide!",
      "company_response": "",
      "reviewer": {
        "name": "Anonymous",
        "location": "",
        "reviews_count": null

    {
      "stars": 1,
      "title": "Appeared to want to help",
      "text": "Appeared to want to help. No hassle and no credit check. Just send a copy of your last pay stub. But they kept wanting more pictures of mine because they couldn’t see the info clearly on it! They also didn’t tell you they need your tax transcripts. Just sign some documents. They clearly see you can pay for a loan and then still don't lend. I have a great credit history! Don’t waste your time with this company! They really don’t care about nurses or healthcare workers going through COVID-19! So do not send any more flyers to my house!\n\nSee the reply. It is funny I got a loan from someone else no hassle. So don’t advertise how simple the process is when it is not. Your personable representatives who kept calling me to complete my loan did not even have the decency to notify by email or call themselves. So much for caring, personal service. I don’t believe the hype your company wants to spread. And your reply implies I could be a bad risk which is not true. I think this could partly be a scam and I should have known better!",

    {
      "stars": 1,
      "title": "Poor customer service",
      "text": "I have a card, had a card with them. I’ve paid the balance in full every time. We’re talking hundreds and thousands of dollars sometimes. With everything that’s been going on with COVID-19 I forgot to pay my current bill. Wasn’t a lot $57. As I soon as I recognized it, I paid it. Two days later, I got a letter from third party collections. This company doesn’t give a care about you. No phone call or anything. Any customer service oriented company would’ve looked at my past standing and at least given a phone call, maybe check on how I was doing during this pandemic. Not these guys. Straight to collections. The timing of it was tone deaf and infuriating especially over a small amount. That’s why I cancelled these guys. They don’t offer anything special over other banks. Certainly not customer service. Please keep that in mind.",

      "stars": 5,
      "title": "BHG seamless process!",
      "text": "As most of us are depending on the federal government to help us navigate through these tough financial times, I’ve decided to not depend on the feds because I’ve come to the realization that for us high income earners will never get anything for our hard earned money. Unless we are part of corporate America, we will not see a single penny from the federal government. Having said that BHG has been more than helpful with my situation. No tedious paper work or forms to fill out, just my P&Ls for the last year and a quarter as well as my tax returns for the last 2 years.       "stars": 5,
      "title": "Thank you BHG for a real loan that I can carry on business with.",
      "text": "I sent in a loan inquiry through lending tree and was immediately overwhelmed by callers. Most of which are sharks. BHG was not the first and did not pressure me as some of the others did. I was assured that they were not a high interest lender as most of the others and they could provide a term loan over 48 months. I was very happy and surprised when they came back with an offer for a 6 figure loan up to 84 months. Interest was a little higher than a bank, which I expected, but no where near the rates others gouge you with. Application and funding into my account was a matter of 5 days. Everyone I talked to ( Alisa, David, Kala, and Jason were great). They got me out of a high interest short term loan which was cost me much more. Thanks BHG!",

    {
      "stars": 2,
      "title": "Loan sharks for the physician in…",
      "text": "Loan sharks for the physician in immediate need. They are courteous, and they do process high loan amounts quickly. However, with this risk to them, comes a great price from us, the clients. They charge more than twice the interest rates of standard banks. This would be acceptable, except for the fact they do not allow repayment of the loan principal for the first three years after you take out the loan. So, even if you can pay back the loan within months to a year, you're forced to pay their high interest and let it accrue for at least three years. they also tack on 10-15% processing fees for the loan amount, which is added to the loan amount you will owe. If you are in dire need, yes, they are there for quick funding. But know that their service comes with a very high price. Also be aware that most the reviews here are high because they barrage you with prompts to leave reviews while you're in that grateful/relief stage right after you get your loan. I waited over a year. This is my response about the cumulative experience.",
      "company_response": "",
      "reviewer": {
        "name": "Anonymous",
        "location": "",
        "reviews_count": null
      },
      "date": {
        "published": "2020-01-23T21:03:44.000Z",

      "text": "I've been contacted several times by phone because I expressed interest a couple of times online.     {
      "stars": 3,
      "title": "BHG was pretty good to work with",
      "text": "BHG was pretty good to work with. They are too eager to give you money that they don't give the client or they make the client feel pressured to have everything ready that day. Some processes take time and BHG is not one to wait. They want to give you the money right then.\nWhen the loan was processed they always sell the loan to someone else. I received a late notice and fee because the connection between BHG and the other bank was not created. Even though I was on with BHG, I was late with the other bank they sold their loan to. BHG should have had the late fee not me.\nAt the end of the loan they try to have you use their credit card. Their selling point is the loan and the credit card don't show up on a credit report. That can be a good thing but for me its not because it would help my credit score not hurt it.\nThe biggest draw back is they don't have an online portal to look at your loan and pay it off or pay more on it. You have to call them to arrange all that. Its very dated and behind.\nWould I do business with them again? Yes, only because they are so eager to give you money they make it easy. I would prefer a different lender though.",

      "title": "Loan Sharks!!!! outrageous fees,high interest rates and liars!",
      "text": "I applied for this a loan through this loan shark of a company. I had to jump through a thousand hoops ,send this and that....meet w/ metro for identity verifications..and was then told \"everything is great\" --you'll have your money in your bank acct within 48hrs. I then did an interview and was asked how my experience was....then i was solicited a bank card. this was a Thursday afternoon. when i got home from work i had a message that they \"forgot \" to have me sign a release form to review the last 10years of my IRS filings!!! they \"forgot\" this piece of important info until the 11th hour??? bullcrap! this loan shark company (they wanted me to pay $3400 in fees just to obtain a small loan of $19,000!! ,at an interest rate of 17.9% over 8 years, without the ability to prepay any of the money within the first 4 years!!!). Outrageous!!!! I refused these terms and they made me a better deal but still crazy! I refused to sign the release for them to look at 10years of my IRS filings! i have always paid my taxes and never had problems w/ IRS! Stay away from these unprofessional fraudulent loan sharks! go to a real bank! Horrible waste of time and very upsetting! glad i didnt get a loan from them!!!",

    {
      "stars": 3,
      "title": "Get more details on early repayment!!",
      "text": "I have a business loan with BHG. The only (big) problem I have with them is that I was told I could pay the loan off early. What was not disclosed, is that you need to pay off the loan in full in order to pay it off early. Partial payments will not be accepted. Therefore, if you want to pay a little extra each month or make an occasional extra payment, you can’t. This likely prevents most individuals from paying the loan off early. The interest rate is almost 10 % on my loan, so that’s painful. I believe this was quite misleading. Otherwise, dealing with them monthly has been fairly easy. I have accidentally paid late once or twice without a penalty, which was nice. I had taken the loan out with plans on paying it back in just a few years with double payments and now, am forced to pay back over a much longer time period and a much higher amount unless I can pay the whole thing back st once. 😡",

    {
      "stars": 4,
      "title": "Combined Effort lead to being Satified",
      "text": "This was a combined effort by my wife and I as she travels. So I am writing review on her behalf as I did most of the dealing with BHG as much as was allowable, like getting BHG the paperwork they needed and updating my wife as to what else they needed before it got to coming to an agreement on how much was needed and what the rate was. I am giving BHG a rate of 4 for the simple reason that I do not feel the process was a up front as I needed. I believe when you are use to going into a bank to do business and the fact that there is a lot of fraud these days that BHG (NOT BE LOCAL) should put out a very clear outline of exactly what the process is from the very first person that reaches out to you from their company. So I am putting the process here so everyone will know. .... You the borrower will need to provide tax returns for I believe 2 years, most current pay stub and once the amount is determined, they will present you with an offer of how much they will lend and what your interest rate is. While I do not know what a good interest is, I do no know that it is based on how much of a credit risk you are (Which is based on your debt level) then they will send someone out to verify that you are actually who you say you are, once you have agreed upon a loan term.\n\nI am saying all of this because I believe in the end that BHG came thru for us and gave us a loan that will definitely meet our needs and I feel had we known the complete process from the beginning and possibly even had some references we could had reached out to that it would had gone even smoother and I could have given a rating of 5 Star.\n\nBased on what I have written, you decide if it should be 4 star or 5 start.\n\nI can be found on Facebook so feel free to reach out to me for a reference.\n\nJack A Starnes",

    {
      "stars": 2,
      "title": "I was very hesitant about trying this…",
      "text": "I was very hesitant about trying this company but after constantly getting mail I decided to try them out. I called,gave them my code from the mailer and began the application process. Basically they just ask how much $$ you have saved and in retirement funds etc. After that you send them W2 and esign a document stating the info you gave them is true. Oh before all this they do a soft credit pull while you are on the phone. I was told my score was 740 and I had a bill I pay $150 a month. I was asking for $15,000 for a rental rehab. Although I did not select the property I wanted to get the loan now and pretty much have it repaid before I got the property.\n\nThe company says 24 hour decision...did not happen with me. I called and I was told still with underwriter. Then 48 hours no answer or communication. I started to get nervous so on the 3rd day I wrote my loan offer and he said he was out the office and was not able to write me back to say I was denied. I was told I would receive a letter in 5 days. He did not give me a reason for the denial.\n\nJust other facts I have a 100% repayment on all bills no late payments, I dont have a lot of bills just student loans and 1 credit card that I pay that total 350 per month. I am a little discourage but I think I will try Sofi. Good luck to the rest of you.\n\nUPDATE. As you may see below my initial review the company told me to call immediately to discuss my situation and I did. They connected me back with the loan officer who processed my loan. I told him I was told to call and he seemed confused as to why I would be calling. He told me to wait until I received the letter in the mail to see why I was denied. I decided that I was done with this all together...2 weeks later I still have not received a letter.\n\nThis company works for some which is good...but not all.\nTHE GOOD NEWS\nI went to Lending Tree and filled out the questionnaire which included a soft pull. The loan amount I asked for was $16,000.\nThey presented me with tons of preliminary offers. I chose First Midwest Bank after reading nothing but positive reviews.\nLong story short\nTHURS Filled out app\nFRI Loan Approved, document verification done included pay stub, w2, and ID\nMON signed contract through esign\nTUES $16,000 in my account\nMy rate 6.4%!!!!!!! Who can beat that. Oh they pull from Trans Union and only report to Trans Union.\n\nIf Bankers does not work for you dont give up if you know you are worthy of the loan and a good rate!",

      "title": "I was a bit skeptical at first.......but the story has a happy ending.",
      "text": "I was a bit skeptical upon receiving the BHG offer in the mail. Having previously received many financial firms send offers that seems to be too good to be real. Shortly they came back with terms and conditions that were less than desirable, so I said \"No thanks, I've better ways to secure the financing at better rates.\" Two days later, I received a call from a senior finance manager who had reviewed my folder and not only was the new rate 1.5% lower than the first offer, but the new terms were fair and acceptable. After a few more days of signing documents to loan was approved and money transferred into my account. I would recommend BHG to other professionals who are in need of financial assistance.     {
      "stars": 1,
      "title": "Getting a Loan",
      "text": "I have attempted 2 times to acquire a small business loan with this company over the past 2 years. My first attempt was in 2017 when I was opening my practice. I was looking for a small 50k loan for part of my start up cost. While I understood at that time as a new start up I had no history to show a viable business which made it less likely to get a loan, however I remember my rep telling me they tend to do bigger loans in the 500k range and he might be better able to help me if I went that route. 2 years later as I looked for an even smaller 35K to expand due to great growth, I was still denied despite having excellent credit ratings. It makes me wonder what kind of commitment they have for small business, and are they interested in the bigger companies. The worst is that I wasted 10 days time waiting for an answer which also required me to call 2x to even get an ETA on when I would hear. So much for getting answers in 24 hrs and your funds in 3 days! I just hope my request for then to stop sending the monthly offers with the plastic credit card attached with my name on it will stop . Dr. Rob",

    {
      "stars": 1,
      "title": "Beware!!!",
      "text": "I have now done 2 loans with this company. The first one was in 2017, and it went fine. I needed another loan earlier this year. I have excellent credit and very high income, but I needed a loan in order to purchase a large piece of property. This 2nd loan has been a disaster. I can't get anyone to return my phone calls, emails, or text messages. My loan officer (Joe Todora) is now MIA. I have tried to reach him all week to ask a question about my loan to no avail. Just closing this 2nd loan was such a nightmare. BHG racked up $10K in legal fees to in order to use my purchased land as collateral for the 2nd loan, and BHG now refuses to pay the lawyers even though they promised to pay all closing cost. What a scam! This is not a knee jerk review because like I said, I have used BHG in the past without complaint, but after all of this, I would not recommend BHG to anyone. While you will get your money faster than using a bank, BHG has acted totally unprofessional, they have been impossible to get in contact with, and they give you nothing but the run around. If you can use a bank...use one!!!",

    {
      "stars": 5,
      "title": "EXCELLENT SERVICE, LEGIT BUSINESS",
      "text": "I received a letter in the mail stating I got pre approved for a loan amount. It looked like a scam, but I called the next day and spoke to Mike. He went over the process and the turnaround time for an answer. Initially he asked for my 1040 forms, but my loan went to another agent named Anthony Patterson. He told me all he needed was me to submit my application and a recent pay stub. Within 24 hours he contacted and told me I was approved for a loan amount of $53K over 7 years. My interest rate is high at 14%, which is probably how they get paid because it is a lot. My credit score is 790 with little debt so I was a little surprised at how high it is. Anyways, I need it for some home improvements. They had someone come and meet me (wherever I wanted) to confirm my identity. I was skeptical at first and had my husband come with me, but it was legit. The rep came, verified with me. All in all, it took 6 days to get approved and have the funds in my account. There is NO PREPAYMENT penalties which I thought was good. This company is legit! I seriously thought it was a scam and was terrified because I gave out personal info, but it's real. No complaints this far, just planning to pay off this loan a lot sooner than 7 years. Also, the Anthony did mention that if I didn't need the full amount which was offered to me I can send it back to the bank and the interest will only accrue on the amount I decide to keep. Good luck with your loan, but so far it's been excellent service.",
      "company_response": "",
      "reviewer": {
        "name": "Anonymous",
        "location": "",
        "reviews_count": null

    {
      "stars": 1,
      "title": "Business loan thru BHG that highlights…FRAUDULENT ACTIVITY, SLOPPY ACCOUNTING AND COMPLACENT COMMUNICATION",
      "text": "Business loan thru BHG that highlights sloppy accounting practices, fraudulent activity of \"partner\" banks and inattention to important financial dealings.\n\nBusiness loan paid off in early August 2018, confirmed with customer service and amount sent that included a couple more days of interest in case transfer took longer than expected. Loan satisfied on time, confirmed with customer service and reassured no further draws on checking account.\n\nSince that time, TWO additional draws on checking account occurred, each of which I had to call BHG to inquire about. Was told after 1st one that it was an \"accounting oversight:\" and money refunded (without interest) and reassured no further issues will happen.\n\nSeveral weeks later, the \"partner\" bank withdrew a larger amount of money out of checking on a loan paid over a month ago. This amount was large in comparison to typical payment and my bank considers it fraud, and so do I. Once again, it took ME contacting BHG to find out what was going on since I did not recognize amount or Bank so was not sure it had anything to do with BHG loan. Apparently this Bank (Empire) is a \"partner\" bank and was told there was a system error......\n\nSo, system error that takes an amount nowhere near the typical loan payment on a loan already satisfied and NO notification from BHG or Enterprise, only a big fat withdrawal from checking that screams fraud and caused us to close down account and change account numbers - now going thru painful process of changing all automatic withdrawals and deposits, etc. Apparently they are going to reverse the transaction, but too late to help reverse the necessary change of accounts the bank fraud department recommended given the circumstances....doubt the reversal will include any interest either on the float of funds they enjoyed.\n\nTo top things off, BHG never refunded the additional interest I included on payoff to ensure enough funds where there to satisfy loan. I expected them to look at loan, apply payment and refund excess, but nothing UNTIL I asked THEM.\n\nBEWARE - getting funds from BHG not an issue, but fraudulent activity surrounding withdrawals from account after loan payoff, combined with sloppy accounting practices and complacent communication are a setup for difficulties.",
      "company_response": "",
      "reviewer": {
        "name": "Anonymous",
        "location": "",
        "reviews_count": null
      },
      "date": {
        "published": "2018-08-09T16:04:56.000Z",
        "experience": ""
      },
      "metadata": {

        "useful_votes": 0,

      "stars": 5,
      "title": "INTO THE GREAT WIDE OPEN",
      "text": "I had an opportunity to change my practice to take advantage of an option that arose from the changing environment in medicine. In order to take advantage of this opportunity, I required a restructuring of my debt and funds to make the transition. The Bankers Healthcare Group enabled me to make the quick financial moves required to take advantage of this opportunity. Like a rebel without a clue, I applied online for a loan; a risk I would have never taken in the past. The Senior Account Executive for my application was Jeffery Gruebele. He handled my account in a very professional manner, with an impressive insight into the particular requirements of my professional corporate structure. There was also the Customer Support Specialist, Ely Rosario-Loveless, available for questions. The operational procedures followed by BHG addressed my concerns and relieved my anxiety over conducting financial transactions online and over the phone. The Funding Coordinator, Ashley Goldberg, was very courteous and efficient in completing the process. The loan was processed and funds deposited into my account in a matter of days.\nI am completely satisfied with the service and advice provided by Mr. Jeffery Gruebele and his team at BHG.     {
      "stars": 5,
      "title": "Pain free loan",
      "text": "When I received the mailer from BHG promising an end to the credit card misery, I took it as yet another attempt by the financial industry to increase its number of applicants, without increasing the number of approvals!\nI am a surgeon 3 years into practice with a large family. After spending 9 years in training ( 5 residency and 4 fellowship) , I was looking forward to getting out of credit card debt accumulated over the years if having to maintain 2 separate households during the fellowship. At last I was back with my family , in a new house ready to begin a new chapter in my life. I always thought with my income growing, I should be able to get a loan easily in view of the stellar repayment record on my accounts. How wrong I was . In the view of financial industry, my credit utilization was all that mattered , never mind the circumstances of debt accumulation and the ability to repay. After having tried multiple times and being rejected for a loan to repay the debts , I was despondent of ever getting a loan.\nSo it was a pleasant surprise when I called The number in ththe mailer. The person explained to me that the company worked only with physicians and was able to approve most loans. Getting the approval was great. After some rate and term negotiations I was able to close on the loan within 1 week with funds in my account within 24 hours of the approval as promised.\nI will recommend this company to all physician a looking for a loan . In fact this company will have my business for any future needs.",
